scope: Exact recipient-specific Forum user-mention description and audience composition for topic and reply targets

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.mention_recipient: the exact mentioned user from the persisted relation event
policy.description: when recipient context is published, describe a topic or reply mention only if the exact mentioned recipient can view the current target
policy.audience: re-resolve the exact mentioned recipient and current target before returning the single-recipient audience
policy.capability_absence: preserve the existing public-only fail-closed mention path when the host recipient-context capability is absent
policy.recipient_unavailable: non-retryable recipient capability failure returns no descriptor or an empty audience without an existence oracle
policy.authenticated_visibility: compose exact base topic visibility and normalized inherited category/topic audience layers for the validated mentioned recipient
policy.local_selectors: role and explicit-user allow or deny constraints resolve without host facts adapters
policy.fact_dependent_selectors: missing or failing host facts capability preserves typed retryability
policy.reply_target: reply must be active and approved and its topic must be visible to the same mentioned recipient
policy.topic_created_boundary: topic-created description and subscription audience remain public-only in this slice
policy.stale_descriptor: audience resolution rechecks the current target policy for the exact mentioned recipient

not_delivered: recipient-specific topic-created subscription filtering before pagination
host trust channel and group facts adapters
final notification creation and delivery authorization
search index SEO and deep-link migration
